full_judgment: 5. Under Article 16 of the order (as amended) the Director General. (Bangladesh Rifles) may delegate, to such extent in/el in respect of such sub-ordinate officer of such Rifleman or signalman as he may think fit, the powers conferred upon him by any provision of the order to any superior officer. It appears from the papers produced before us that in exercise of the powers conferred by Article 16 of the order the Director General delegated his powers under Article 11 (1) of the order by an order dated 14 October 1985 and in terms of the said delegation a Deputy Director when appointed a sector commander may exercise the powers of the Director General under Article 11 (with some limitation which is not relevant here) in respect of sub-Ordinate officers (J. 0. Cs) of all class (ranks).
